title: Bursa Malaysia Main Market and ACE Market Listing Requirements, sustainability reporting amendments (IFRS S1 and S2)
citation: Bursa Malaysia amendments to the Main Market and ACE Market Listing Requirements, media release of 23 December 2024
evidence: Not re-read on 2026-11-02: www.bursamalaysia.com answers every request, including this release PDF, with a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403). The existing register row, read by an earlier run, records staged commencement from 2025-01-01 through 2027-01-01 by cohort (large issuers 2025, other Main Market issuers 2026, ACE 2027); that is not restated as a single date here.
notes: Maps the existing MY row in register.csv (matched on the media release URL). Exchange rules under the Capital Markets and Services Act 2007 are binding on listed issuers but the Listing Requirements are not enacted statute. Row MY-BURSA-ADOPTED is permission requested (terms unreadable, Cloudflare). The Practice Note 9 text and the 2022 sustainability statement provisions were not opened. The SC's National Sustainability Reporting Framework (https://www.sc.com.my/nsrf) is a framework, not law, and has no scope entry. Languages: the LOM serves Malay (BM) and English (BI) versions; the National Language Acts 1963/67 make the Malay text authoritative for federal law, which the LOM terms page does not state, so that is not relied on here. No record is stored, so no language file exists. No government English translation was looked for beyond the LOM English version.
status_note: Terms unreadable from the cloud address; permission not requested. Not stored.
